$comment: The 1444 tongues of each map realm (CULT-009, CULT-086), mapped once from the catalogue's culture strings; shares are provisional. tongues: tongues not already in culture.json. realms: map nation id -> court tongue and up to three tongues with shares of the people.

local.french: Burgundians of the duchy and county (French-speaking)

local.andalusi_arabic: Mudéjar (Muslim) communities, large in Valencia and Aragon

local.italian: Central Italian (Roman, Umbrian, Marchigian, Romagnol) populations
local.emilian: Central Italian (Roman, Umbrian, Marchigian, Romagnol) populations

local.greek: Greek communities in Calabria and Salento

local.slovene: Slovene-speaking population in Carniola, Lower Styria and southern Carinthia

local.high_german: German burghers and settlers in towns

local.french: Latin knights (French, Italian, Spanish, English, German)

local.komi: Finnic groups (Merya descendants, Mordvins, Komi) in the east and north

local.estonian: Setos and Estonians on the border

local.kazan_tatar: Kazan Tatars (settled Muslim population of Bulgar heritage with Kipchak elements)

local.crimean_tatar: Crimean Tatars of the leading clans (Kipchak-speaking)

local.uzbek: Uzbek tribes (Qiyat, Qongirat, Mangit, Durman, Ushun, Naiman and others)
local.ob_ugrian: Ugrian and Siberian forest peoples on the northern margins

local.circassian: Circassian, Turkic and other mamluk elite

local.persian: Persian (Tajik) sedentary population of cities and oases

local.tay: Tai (Tai Dam, Tai Don), Tày and Nùng in the uplands

local.jarai: Highland Chamic (Jarai, Rhade) and Mon-Khmer peoples

local.maghrebi_arabic: Arabic-speaking urban population of Fez and the ports, including Andalusi émigrés
local.masmuda: Zenata, Masmuda and Sanhaja Berber groups
local.zenata: Zenata, Masmuda and Sanhaja Berber groups

local.nahua: Mexica, Acolhua, Tepanec and other Nahua
local.otomi: Otomi and Mazahua in the north and west

local.aymara: Conquered and allied Andean peoples (Chanka and others)
